description: A horizontal row of large-number metrics with labels. Use for quantified credentials or social proof (e.g. '+30 years experience', '100+ clients').

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Optional section heading above the stats row. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

theme.description: Background color/tone for this band. 'default' = the band's own default background (no tone override). 'muted' = light tinted surface band (renders the --color-surface background with framing top and bottom borders). 'inverted' = inverted dark background for strong contrast; use 'inverted' for a genuinely dark band.

background_image.description: Optional background image URL. When set, renders as a CSS background-image with a dark overlay for text readability.

items.description: Array of stat items. Each: { number: string, label: string }.

number.description: The metric value, e.g. '+30' or '100+'. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

label.description: The metric label, e.g. 'Years of experience'. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

--stats-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--stats-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--stats-heading-size.description: Section heading (title) font size. Defaults to the shared responsive band-heading scale (fluid ~28px mobile to ~42px desktop), which every band heading in the theme routes. LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ from the rest of the site: the shared scale is not a design token and no action in the write path can retune it, so setting this slot changes THIS band only and never the others.

--stats-heading-color.description: Section heading text color. Defaults to the theme text colour (the inverted variant supplies its own light default). LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ: recolouring every heading on the site is ONE update_design_token write on --color-text, not one slot write per band.

--stats-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the stats section heading (title). Routes the shared --measure-heading design token (40rem) by default, so retuning that ONE token changes every routed band heading at once; set a length here only when THIS band must differ from the rest of the site.

--stats-heading-margin-bottom.description: Space below the stats heading, before the number row (header rhythm). Lower it to tighten the header, raise it for more separation. Not a band-fusing lever: the number row always renders after the heading, so the seam with the band below is closed with --stats-padding-bottom.

--stats-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the heading. Ignored unless title_accent is set AND occurs as a substring of title — no accent span is rendered otherwise, so this slot has nothing to colour.

--stats-number-color.description: Stat number (large metric value) text color

--stats-number-size.description: Stat number (large metric value) font size

--stats-number-font.description: Stat number (large metric value) font family. Defaults to inherit, so the number keeps the page body font exactly as before. Set to var(--font-heading) to make the display figures follow the heading system (a serif/display brand face), or give any comma-separated font stack.

--stats-number-weight.description: Stat number (large metric value) font weight, as a unitless number (e.g. 600). Defaults to 700. Pair with --stats-number-font when the heading face needs a different weight than the bold body default.

--stats-label-color.description: Stat label text color. Ink only — the label's SIZE (0.875rem) is a stated default with no slot: the number is the band's display element, which is why --stats-number-* carries four slots, and the label is deliberately a fixed secondary caption beneath it. Worth knowing before you raise --stats-number-size: the label does not follow it, so a much larger number leaves the caption proportionally smaller. See components/stats/README.md, 'Stated defaults'

--stats-overlay-bg.description: Scrim laid over background_image on this band. Defaults to the shared --overlay-bg; darken or lighten it per instance to tune legibility over a particular photo. The fourth background-image component to gain this slot (hero, section and cta already had it).

--stats-radius.description: Border radius of the stats band. VISIBLE ONLY IN COMBINATION WITH A BACKGROUND PAINT: on the default theme --stats-bg is unset, so the band is transparent and a radius rounds nothing you can see. Set --stats-bg (or use the muted/inverted theme, or a background_image) first, then pair with --stats-max-width for a contained, rounded metrics card.

--stats-max-width.description: Maximum width of the stats band. When set, the band is capped to this width and centered (auto side margins), producing a contained card; the default 'none' spans full width unchanged.

do_not_touch: schema.json without updating this component's README.md and the repo-root AI_CONTEXT.md
